segments.oily: The one reviewer who describes oily, acne-prone, sensitive skin reports no breakouts and a good experience with the mask.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin mostly describe the mask as hydrating, plumping and barrier-supportive, including one who called it a big improvement after a dry winter, but one reviewer with dry, mature skin found it very drying and disruptive to her skin barrier.
segments.sensitive: Most reviewers with sensitive skin, including several with rosacea, report no irritation or breakouts and describe the mask as calming, though one esthetician with sensitive skin developed red, irritated bumps after two uses.
segments.mature: Reviewers who mention mature skin (late 30s to 50s) are mostly positive, calling it a favorite for keeping skin glowing and soft, though one reviewer in her 50s says it disrupted her barrier and was too drying for mature, drier skin.

concerns.dehydration: Reviewers with dry skin mostly report the mask leaving skin hydrated, plump and softer, with one describing a noticeable improvement after a dry winter and another using it specifically to support a compromised barrier; one reviewer with mature, dry skin found the opposite, calling the mask very drying and disruptive to her skin barrier.
concerns.redness: A reviewer with rosacea reports the mask helped reduce redness and felt soothing with no irritation or tingling, and another rosacea-prone reviewer had no reaction; however, one reviewer with sensitive skin developed a red, puffy line and later a cluster of red, irritated bumps after repeated use.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer with dry, sometimes-sensitive skin bought the mask specifically hoping it would support her skin barrier and found her skin felt good afterward; conversely, a reviewer with mature, dry skin says the mask disrupted her skin barrier significantly and left it very dry.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers, including several who describe oily, acne-prone or sensitive skin, report no new breakouts even with repeated use; a couple of others note small bumps appearing after application, and one reviewer with sensitive skin experienced a cluster of red, irritated bumps around the eyes, cheek and nose.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer with oily, acne-prone, sensitive skin says the mask caused no breakouts and worked well for her; another describes the finish as hydrated and refreshed but not oily.
